CANONICAL source_id AND EO CREDIT. Consolidated rev 9 (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-06 16:52Z). It replaces all earlier revisions, which remain in history as superseded. It is based on Greg's words relayed by Engram::Asistant (#569, #574, #576, #578, #583, #586, #592, #594, #596, #598), and the definition comes from Kimi::Consultant (TermAl mailbox 852a55c9 #71 and #73), agreed by TermAl and Engram.
source_id = ONE object describing the source state, produced only by `engram source` (Engram owns it):
- root: commit (HEAD) and tree;
- submodules: path and actual HEAD for each, from `git submodule status --recursive`; expected pins come from the root commit;
- changes[]: only the local delta, from `git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all --ignore-submodules=none`, with path, status, origin (for renames), mode or type, and the Git blob id from `git hash-object --stdin-paths` (default filters, no -w), computed over the dirty paths only. Deletions are tombstones. Untracked non-ignored files are included. Ignored files are excluded absolutely. Only dirty or off-pin submodules recurse; an uninitialized or conflicted submodule makes the result unavailable. Clean means changes = [].
Bounds (Greg accepted: „mysle, ze to rozsadne ograniczenie w wiekszosci przypadkow, git diff jest pusty”): at most 1 MiB of JSON and 8 s; overflow, timeout, drift seen by a stat-and-status recheck, filters, or any error means unavailable. A partial result is never returned.
Never: watcher events, hashing anything in the .git directory, or a full repository or index listing.
EO credit (Greg: „to jest wystarczajacy warunek ... mysle, ze i tak jest za silny, ale zacznijmy od tego”): the full source_id at S0 (before the prompt is dispatched) equals the full source_id after the declared test; local changes are allowed. The declared test must be the turn's first tool action; the result goes out as the existing verification_record_v1, with the existing artifact, identity and claim checks. There is no clean-repository requirement and no watcher. Clean is only a landing policy.
Accepted, documented limits: a change fully reverted between S0 and the after capture; anything git status does not report (hidden index flags, edits inside .git); changes to ignored files.
Rollout: `engram source` gains the new fields in its existing JSON (no v2); TermAl's and Engram's strict readers are updated in the same window. Consumers then move off content-v1 one at a time. Old records stay readable as stored.
Rule: no new conditions, mechanisms or gates without Greg's explicit word. Items: Engram w-a6c91d6a7f27 (E1); TermAl w-6f42c416b0c7 (M1, then consumer switch, C1 to C6) and w-24a72c898d6d (EO).

Addendum, 2026-11-07 (Termal::Fable2).
(1) Greg (Asistant #670, 02:25Z): „Usuniecie content-v1 to follow up a nie warunek konieczny.” Removing content-v1 is a follow-up; it does not block Unified EO delivery.
(2) Greg (Asistant #665/#503, 02:22Z): „Nie bedziemy czekac na rozwiazanie 8 sekund. Wtf. Ciagle za 2 dni.” The 8 s source-capture question is diagnosed separately and does not gate EO; a quiet Central measured 2.65 s.
(3) Plan agreed with Engram::Fable and Opus2:
- ONE joint restart, about 07:30–08:00Z on 2026-11-07 (Central and DL560), after w-7daf, M1, w-24a7 and w-8f4c land and install, pipelined with parallel DL560 and Windows FULLs;
- then the w-e072 live proof;
- Engram E2 increment 1 lands with no restart.

Addendum 2, 2026-11-07 06:25Z (Termal::Fable2).

Restart 1 is done at about 06:04Z, on Central 36e5c9d4 / exe b31c9ab9 and DL560 36e5c9d4 / 9adb0bd3. Engram on Central is 2bd73a352dd2 (E3(b)).

Greg: „konczmy EO, po tym, bedziemy mogli zrobic reszte” (Asistant #712). EO has absolute slot priority, and everything else is a follow-up. The combined plan went to Greg in Engram::Fable's Asistant #525, which supersedes my #713. EO is complete end to end at about 12:30–13:30Z if w-8f4c needs no further Medium rounds.

Order:
- w-e072 live proof (Opus2): Questly Windows, Questly Linux, Phoenix Windows (after NET10), Phoenix Linux (after the DL560 E3(b) install and the session-16661 store init);
- w-8f4c (Sol-03d4): fix, pair, FULLs;
- restart 2;
- Engram E2 lands right after restart 2. Its precondition is that w-8f4c's readers are RUNNING. Its FULL can run before then, and it needs no restart of its own;
- `done` closures.

I dropped w-e072's prerequisite w-24a7, which was circular.

Addendum 3, 2026-11-07 06:33Z (Termal::Fable2). BOUND CHANGE by Greg (Asistant #734, 06:31Z, final, don't ask again): „8 sekund jest za mało. Podnieśc do 30 sec. Takie sztywne limity bardzo duzo nas kosztuja poprawek i marnowanego czasu.” The source_id time bound is now 30 s; the 1 MiB bound is unchanged.
- TermAl: w-7ebf80832c3f (P0, Sol-a7bb). It covers the S0, after and notice capture budgets, the `engram source` subprocess budget with its --timeout-ms (capped at 8000 today), and the opening deadline. It rides restart 2 with w-8f4c.
- Engram: its own `engram source` bound, owned by Engram::Fable.
The trigger was Questly Windows C1 S0 at 8.09 s under load (2.8 s standalone). Lesson: Greg treats rigid tight limits as costly. Prefer generous bounds and raise them early, rather than tuning around them.

Addendum 4, 2026-11-07 06:41Z (Termal::Fable2). MILESTONE: the first real-consumer native credit end to end, C1 Questly WINDOWS, on TermAl 36e5c9d4 and Engram 0cfb2341.
- Questly::Codex2, run test-3fdba48d: 1820/0/0.
- source_id S0 == after: f50714e9 / cf0d0ce6, submodule b951c661.
- Verification record 6c8175824c0d47cd93dd4ff92ddbd6b8 was received.
- Questly item w-d96f586eea8f is done without evaluation, seal 162bda3c.
Codex's truncated console output did not block it. output_cut blocked only the Claude path (Questly Linux), and w-37d945d4b7ca (Sol-c593) is removing it, with a retro-credit attempt for test-d6a9e68d.
Remaining in C1: Questly Linux (w-37d9), Phoenix Windows (Greg's commit and push word for .NET 10 is pending), Phoenix Linux. C2 (no credit after a source change) is still to be shown.

Addendum 5, 2026-11-07 21:25Z (Termal::Fable2): UNIFIED EO COMPLETE. TermAl w-e072a871549f was marked done at 21:24:38Z (seal b1f9648c), after restart 3 onto master fdbb53c8 (w-7e09 re-claim fence, w-f5b8 Linux deleted-exe, w-65a9 named source-change reason, content-v1 C1, race-test fix). Live proofs: Questly Windows, Phoenix Windows (6dbad90f), Questly Linux (bf2c3c19), Phoenix Linux (0217e45e, 12/12, 5786218 / 0c1d9898); C2 named reason on Linux (test-c88e8bbe, source_changed with path). Builds: DL560 TermAl 084dd9f0 + Engram 28ebd6c4; Central TermAl 7f02d86e + Engram 3cb2f9b3. Related items closed: w-24a7, w-37d9, w-7ebf, w-8f4c. Follow-ups: content-v1 C2/C3 (w-6f42) with Engram w-d9db; w-62605; w-a8af; w-59e7; w-463c; Phoenix w-14c5.
